tiles.title: Sessions
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = count()

tiles.title: People
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = dcountif(AadObjectId, isnotempty(AadObjectId))

tiles.title: Agents used
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = dcount(DataverseBotId)

tiles.title: Engagement rate %
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = round(100.0 * countif(IsEngaged) / count(), 1)

tiles.title: Resolution rate %
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = round(100.0 * countif(IsResolved) / countif(IsEngaged), 1)

tiles.title: Median turns
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = percentile(TurnCount, 50)

tiles.title: Sessions over time
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Sessions = count(), Engaged = countif(IsEngaged)
    by bin(SessionStart, 1d)
| order by SessionStart asc

tiles.title: Session outcome
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| extend Outcome = iff(isempty(Outcome), "(none recorded)", Outcome)
| summarize Sessions = count() by Outcome
| order by Sessions desc

tiles.title: Sessions by environment
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Sessions = count() by EnvironmentName
| order by Sessions desc

tiles.title: Busiest agents
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| join kind=leftouter (CopilotAgent() | project BotId, AgentDisplayName = Name)
    on $left.DataverseBotId == $right.BotId
| extend Agent = iff(isempty(AgentDisplayName), BotName, AgentDisplayName)
| summarize Sessions = count(),
            People = dcountif(AadObjectId, isnotempty(AadObjectId)),
            AvgTurns = round(avg(TurnCount), 1)
    by Agent
| order by Sessions desc
| take 15

tiles.title: Channels
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| extend ChannelId = iff(isempty(ChannelId), "(unknown)", ChannelId)
| summarize Sessions = count() by ChannelId
| order by Sessions desc

tiles.title: Agent performance
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| join kind=leftouter (CopilotAgent() | project BotId, AgentDisplayName = Name)
    on $left.DataverseBotId == $right.BotId
| extend Agent = iff(isempty(AgentDisplayName), BotName, AgentDisplayName)
| summarize Sessions = count(),
            People = dcountif(AadObjectId, isnotempty(AadObjectId)),
            EngagementPct = round(100.0 * countif(IsEngaged) / count(), 1),
            ResolutionPct = round(100.0 * countif(IsResolved) / countif(IsEngaged), 1),
            EscalationPct = round(100.0 * countif(IsEscalated) / countif(IsEngaged), 1),
            AvgTurns = round(avg(TurnCount), 1)
    by Agent, EnvironmentName
| order by Sessions desc

tiles.title: Escalation rate by agent
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| join kind=leftouter (CopilotAgent() | project BotId, AgentDisplayName = Name)
    on $left.DataverseBotId == $right.BotId
| extend Agent = iff(isempty(AgentDisplayName), BotName, AgentDisplayName)
| summarize Engaged = countif(IsEngaged), Escalated = countif(IsEscalated)
    by Agent
| where Engaged > 0
| extend EscalationPct = round(100.0 * Escalated / Engaged, 1)
| project Agent, EscalationPct
| top 15 by EscalationPct desc

tiles.title: Turns per session
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Sessions = count() by TurnBucket = bin(TurnCount, 2)
| order by TurnBucket asc

tiles.title: Attribution coverage %
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Attributable = countif(isnotempty(AadObjectId)), Total = count()
| project Value = round(100.0 * Attributable / Total, 1)

tiles.title: People
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Value = dcountif(AadObjectId, isnotempty(AadObjectId))

tiles.title: Sessions per person
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| where isnotempty(AadObjectId)
| summarize Sessions = count(), People = dcount(AadObjectId)
| project Value = round(1.0 * Sessions / People, 1)

tiles.title: Unattributed sessions
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| summarize Attributable = countif(isnotempty(AadObjectId)), Total = count()
| project Value = Total - Attributable

tiles.title: Adoption by department
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| where isnotempty(AadObjectId)
| join kind=leftouter (CopilotUser()) on AadObjectId
| extend Department = iff(isempty(Department), "(unresolved)", Department)
| summarize Sessions = count() by Department
| order by Sessions desc

tiles.title: Adoption by job title
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| where isnotempty(AadObjectId)
| join kind=leftouter (CopilotUser()) on AadObjectId
| extend JobTitle = iff(isempty(JobTitle), "(unresolved)", JobTitle)
| summarize People = dcount(AadObjectId), Sessions = count() by JobTitle
| order by Sessions desc
| take 15

tiles.title: Daily active people
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where IncludeTestPane or not(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false))
| where isnotempty(AadObjectId)
| summarize People = dcount(AadObjectId) by bin(SessionStart, 1d)
| order by SessionStart asc

tiles.title: Agents in tenant
tiles.query:
CopilotAgent()
| summarize Value = count()

tiles.title: Published agents
tiles.query:
CopilotAgent()
| summarize Value = countif(isnotnull(PublishedOn))

tiles.title: Agents with no sessions
Environments with agents
tiles.query:
CopilotAgent()
| summarize Value = dcount(EnvironmentId)

tiles.title: Unused agents
tiles.query:
let used = CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | distinct DataverseBotId;
CopilotAgent()
| where BotId !in (used)
| project Name, EnvironmentName, StateLabel,
          AccessControlPolicyLabel, PublishedOn, CreatedOn
| order by CreatedOn desc

tiles.title: Agents by environment
tiles.query:
CopilotAgent()
| summarize Agents = count() by EnvironmentName
| order by Agents desc

tiles.title: Access control policy
tiles.query:
CopilotAgent()
| extend AccessControlPolicyLabel = iff(isempty(AccessControlPolicyLabel),
    "(unspecified)", AccessControlPolicyLabel)
| summarize Agents = count() by AccessControlPolicyLabel
| order by Agents desc

tiles.title: Test pane share of traffic
tiles.query:
CopilotSession()
| where SessionStart between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| summarize Sessions = count() by Kind = iff(coalesce(IsDesignMode, false),
    "Test pane", "Real traffic")

tiles.title: Environment coverage
tiles.query: CopilotTranscriptCoverage(30d)
